title: Peter Thiel almost intercepted over energy technology

tellings.quote: I was I got a heads up from the the senior MOCI guy and I back channel that information to Eric Weinstein.

plain: The tech investor Peter Thiel was almost intercepted over energy technology, according to Steven Greer, a former doctor who campaigns for UFO disclosure. Greer tells Michels he got a warning from a senior source, whom he calls by an acronym he does not explain, and passed it through a back channel to the mathematician Eric Weinstein. He also names the physicist Hal Puthoff in the story. The claim implies that someone is ready to step in to stop powerful people from pursuing new kinds of energy.
